note: Window agent p0100-p0199, 2 Nov 2026. Tarim Basin 107-199: the dossiers' own notes say the Tarim leaves the Han in 107, returns for 123-124 and the Chief Official until 175, and belongs to no protectorate 176-223; the draft contradicts them because keyframe ranges default to shapes.csv years and overlap.

correction.text: the 106 shape without Fergana and Kyrgyzstan; Tarim cells client land; holds 106 only; plus Hami (100 km disc)

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier note says this shape 'holds 106 only', but without from/to it ran to 116 (shapes.csv) and was unioned with han-dynasty_107, which gave the Han 2,540 Tarim cells in 107-116. The Protectorate page: 'On 29 July 107 ... Duan Xi was killed and the post was abandoned'; it was not restored until 123. Same correction, range cut to 106.

correction.text: unchanged shape, years 123..175 only: the protectorate restored by Ban Yong (123-124) and the Chief Official of the Western Regions, last seen in 175

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier note says the shape holds 123 to 175 only, but without from/to it ran 117-183. Protectorate page: 'The protectorate was later restored from 123 to 124 by the son of Ban Chao, Ban Yong'; Chief Official page: 'last seen in 175'. Same correction, range cut to 123-175.

correction.text: none of the Tarim belongs to this state in 184-196

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier marks this shape wrong ('none of these years belong to this state') but its correction was the shape itself, so the compiler redrew 1,833 cells. Chief Official page: 'last seen in 175'; the office was only 're-established and maintained by the Cao Wei and the Western Jin'. Empty correction.

correction.text: none of the Tarim belongs to this state in 197-223

keyframe_overrides.why: As for 184: the dossier marks 197-223 wrong but its correction was the shape itself (562 cells drawn). Chief Official page: last seen in 175, re-established only by the Cao Wei. Empty correction.

region.text: the whole Tarim Basin and Turfan-Hami, which the protectorate holds after the 125 end of the Han tie

events.note: 176: no protectorate or chief official is recorded in the Tarim. 'The chief official of the Western Regions was last seen in 175' and the office was only 'subsequently re-established and maintained by the Cao Wei and the Western Jin'. The dossier's own loss of 176 takes only the 944-cell Cliopatria shape, leaving 1,351 Tarim cells to the protectorate for 176-199. [Review 2026-11-02: confidence 2 -> 1: the page says only 'last seen in 175', so the year 176 is a bridging judgment, as in the dossier's own 176 loss.]

198: Xu Province passes to Cao Cao. 'Lu Bu was captured and executed on Cao Cao's order, and Xu Province came under Cao's control' (End of the Han page, 198); the page's c. 200 list gives Xu Province as 'covering present-day northern Jiangsu'. The draft left northern Jiangsu to nobody from 192 to 199.
